question: Which of the following country has launched "Hope Probe" mission to Mars in July 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UAE**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The "Hope Probe" mission is the first interplanetary mission undertaken by the **United Arab Emirates (UAE)**.
 
• The mission was launched on **July 20, 2020** from the Tanegashima Space Center in Japan.
 
• The Hope Probe was designed to study the Martian atmosphere and its climate dynamics, aiming to provide a complete picture of the planet’s weather.
 
• The mission is part of the UAE's ambitious space program and represents a significant milestone for the country's scientific and technological advancement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hope Probe**

 
 
• The Hope Probe, also known as Al-Amal in Arabic, is a space probe developed by the UAE Space Agency to explore Mars.
 
• The spacecraft was built by the Mohammed bin Rashid Space Centre (MBRSC), in collaboration with the University of Colorado Boulder, Arizona State University, and the University of California, Berkeley.
 
• The main scientific goal of the mission is to study the Martian atmosphere and understand the climate and weather patterns on Mars.
 
• The probe is equipped with three scientific instruments: an Emirates eXploration Imager (EXI), an Emirates Mars Ultraviolet Spectrometer (EMUS), and an Emirates Mars Infrared Spectrometer (EMIRS) to observe the Martian atmosphere in visible, ultraviolet, and infrared wavelengths respectively.
 
 
 
• **UAE Space Program**
 
 
• The UAE’s space program has been rapidly developing with the goal of positioning the country as a significant player in space exploration.
 
• In addition to the Hope Probe, the UAE has launched satellites such as KhalifaSat and DubaiSat, focusing on Earth observation and remote sensing.
 
• The UAE has also announced plans to establish a human settlement on Mars by 2117, showcasing their long-term vision for space exploration.
 
• The UAE space program is aimed at advancing scientific research, fostering international collaboration, and inspiring future generations of scientists and engineers in the country and the region.
